text: Godel's ___ universe $L$, built up in stages, is a model of ZF in which both AC and GCH hold, proving that CH cannot be disproved from ZF.
explanation: Godel's constructible universe $L = \bigcup_\alpha L_\alpha$ is the inner model satisfying ZF + AC + GCH, yielding $\mathrm{Con}(\mathrm{ZF}) \Rightarrow \mathrm{Con}(\mathrm{ZF}+\mathrm{AC}+\mathrm{GCH})$. It is distinct from the Von Neumann universe $V = \bigcup_\alpha V_\alpha$, which uses full power sets $\mathcal{P}(V_\alpha)$ and need not satisfy GCH.
